noticia: Williams (groin) is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Wizards.
Barlow (back) did not participate in Monday's practice, according to 76ers reporter Paul Hudrick.
The Magic announced Monday that Nelson will undergo surgery to repair a fracture in his left ankle, and he's expected to return to basketball activities in 3-4 months.

Beal (knee) isn't participating in five-on-five work but is doing individual player development work, Tomer Azarly of ClutchPoints.com reports. Azarly adds that the Clippers said Wednesday that Beal is continuing to have inflammation managed.

titular: To miss at least two weeks
noticia: Cardwell will miss at least two weeks with a left calf strain, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.
Coward (wrist) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Warriors.
Murray notched 12 points (4-9 FG, 0-3 3Pt, 4-4 FT), two rebounds, one assist and one steal over 26 minutes during Friday's 128-120 loss to the Trail Blazers.
Boswell is rehabbing a right knee injury, and he's hopeful to be cleared for basketball activities prior to the start of the G League season in late October.
Edey posted eight points (4-6 FG, 0-1 FT), 10 rebounds, three assists, two blocks and one steal over 22 minutes during Friday's 111-108 victory over the Warriors.
Knueppel (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Hawks.
James (back) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Bucks.

titular: Shut down for rest of season
noticia: Niederhauser has been diagnosed with a Lisfranc injury in his right foot and will require surgery. He's been ruled out for the remainder of the 2025-26 season, Joey Linn of SI.com reports.
